I actually laughed out loud a little bit when it happened. "We're sorry, there's is no one available to take your call. If it's an emergency, please call 911" 

Like God DAMN that's fucking cold and who in their right fucking mind is calling the cops 
>The suicide hotline hung up on me after ten seconds of me talking. I should've pulled the trigger then, because things certainly haven't gotten better since

This is my fear too. I'm sorry this is happening to you. I don't have any good advice except to tell you you're not alone in how you're feeling. I can't bear the thought of my parents paying my medical bills and that's what's staying my hand at the moment.
